sources.name: Federal Decree-Law No. 42 of 2022 (Civil Procedure Law)

steps.title: Filing of Civil Claim
steps.description: A civil claim is filed before the competent court through the court registry or electronic filing system, in accordance with UAE Civil Procedure Law.

steps.title: Case Registration and Fee Payment
steps.description: Court registers the case after verification of documents and payment of prescribed court fees.

steps.title: Service of Summons
steps.description: Summons and statement of claim are served on the defendant to appear and submit a defence.

steps.title: Submission of Defence and Replies
steps.description: Defendant submits a memorandum of defence, and parties may exchange written submissions as permitted by the court.

steps.title: Hearings and Evidence
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, examines documentary evidence, and may appoint experts if required.

steps.title: Final Submissions
steps.description: Parties present final written or oral submissions before closure of pleadings.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment deciding the civil dispute.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Judgment may be executed through the execution court if not complied with voluntarily.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under UAE Civil Procedure Law
Appeal on points of law as permitted under UAE law
